Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant for quashing the entire
criminal proceedings of Criminal Case No.966 of 2017, State Vs. Guddu Prasad and others, arising
out of Case Crime No.343 of 2015, under Section 498A I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station
Sehramau Uttari, District Pilibhit pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Pilibhit.
3.  In the present case, criminal proceedings have been challenged.
However, nor the cognizance order neither the summoning order has been challenged.
4. The criminal proceedings cannot be quashed unless the summoning order or cognizance order is challenged.

On a pointed query being made to the learned counsel for the applicant in this respect,
he submits that the summoning order has been annexed with this application.

However, he fairly Guddu Prasad @ Suresh And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130863984/
1 submits that the same is not challenged.
